title: Optimization on Affine-Transversal Hilbert Submanifolds: Part I -- Theoretical Foundations
summary: In this paper, we establish the theoretical foundations for the generic optimization problem in a Hilbert space whose feasible set is an affine-transversal Hilbert submanifold given by the intersection of a nonlinear manifold and an affine subspace. We develop the geometric and analytical toolkit, such as the tangent-space characterization, projection operators, and implicit retraction operators, to essentially ensure the feasibility of iterates for algorithmic design.
